Yashtimadhu mixed with cow’s milk is traditionally used for promoting lactation. Palak contains potassium and vitamin A which is helpful in lactation. Safed jeera contain numerous flavonoids and terpenes and has been used as a galactagogue.

It also helps in managing inflammation in sexual organs and moisturizing the dry tissues in the sexual organs, promoting folliculogenesis as well as ovulation, preparing womb for conception, managing miscarriage, normalizing uterine functioning, and optimizing hormonal activity.

For irregular menstrual cycle, menorrhagia, metrorrhagia, dysmenorrhoea, or oligomenorrhoea, take 1 to 2 teaspoons full of Gynovit Syrup with water before meal three times daily for 3-6 cycles. For leucurrhoea, take 1 to 2 teaspoons of the syrup with water before meal three times daily for 7 days.
